m: A *tiger* waits outside the door and your *heart* thumps: you stop to **consider** your next move.
A goat with *horns* skips over the *drying rack* and lands softly on the *soil*: how **lucky**.
Spread the *soil* under the *blanket*, then press it with a *lid*: smooth and **even**.
*Gold coins* pile up like *sprinkles* under the *moon* as the shop **sells off** its stock.
*Gold coins* paid for a big brass disc with a *bullseye* in the middle: the town **clock**.
A *small speech bubble* floats over the *soil* as a poet taps the beat with a *thumb*: a **poem**.
A *minister* crouches in the tall *grass*: he **hides** from the king.
A *runner* leaps over the *drying rack*: he must **hurry** to catch the bus.
A *lying man* on stage, a *cross*, a *mouth* that cries, a *standing knife*: it is all part of the **play**.
A *cabinet* by the *altar* sells little slips: a **ticket** to the temple fair.
A *helping hand* drops a *shell* and a *mouth* cries out: it is cracked, **harmed**.
You pull the *blanket* over your head and your *heart* forgets the kettle: you **neglect** it.
An *open crate* so big a whole elephant fits inside: **huge**.
A *campfire* lights a fuse under a *blanket*; a *cobra* of smoke shoots out: the **cannon** fires.
A *pole* leans against a *sun*-faded wall: everything here is **old**.
On the *podium* on top of the *mountain*, an old man with a long *beard* stands at the very **end** of the trail.
A *helping hand* pushes through a *torn net* and up a *tree*: it **explores** the jungle.
*Water drops* gather under the *moon* in a big *mouth* of land marked with a *cross* on the map: a **lake**.
A *comb* is dipped in *splashing water* and dragged across paper: it **records** the lines.
A *mouth* blows on a *cross*-veined **leaf** and sends it flying.
*Wheat* sprouts, the *curtains* open and the warm *sun* returns: **spring**.
A *slash* of a path winds through the hills: the **countryside**.
A *standing person* on the *hillside* presses a note on the door with a *thumb*: it is **attached**.
A *mouth* gasps like a *chaser* after a race: you **breathe in** hard.
An *elbow* swings a *fishing line* toward you: "this rod is yours," I **give** it.
At the *small altar* a child on a *ski* slides up to leave a **gift**.
*Water drops*, a *hurdle* of a breakwater, *curtains* of sails and a *cobra*-shaped crane: a busy **harbour**.
Under a *banner* of cloud, drops fall in rows: **rain**.
A *mouth* shows its *fang* in surprise: "**ah**, it's you!"
A *right hand* cuts a *tree* into flat planks by the *leaning cliff*: a **board**.
In the *shed* a man takes a *long stride* with a *shoulder pole* across the **courtyard**.
A *woman* combs her hair with a *comb*: a married **woman** getting ready.
A *comb* in your bag, you head home: you **return**.
An *eye* as green as *moss*: the **eyeball** sparkles.
A *side dish* on a rock by the *leaning cliff*, a *right hand* reaches for it: time for a **meal**.
Under the *roof*, after *trudging feet* bring him home, he puts a *page* on his hot *mouth* and **forehead**.
The *clock* ticks while you hold a sweet in your *mouth*: **keep** it **in the mouth**, don't chew.
A *river* flows on and the *page* floats along with it: it **follows** the current.
The *cart* is wrecked, the *tent* is cut with a *standing knife* under the *moon*: you **lose** the war.
A *helping hand* grabs a branch and **shakes** it hard.
A *knife* waved high, a *mouth* shouting, a *helping hand* beckoning: they **recruit** soldiers.
A *woman* joins a new *family tree* under the bright *sun*: a **marriage**.
Under the *moon*, a man with *horns* on his hat opens his *mouth* to yawn and kicks off his boots from his *legs*: he **takes off** his clothes.
A tailor sews a *fortune stick* pattern over a hole in the *shirt*: he **patches** it.
A *small speech bubble* over the *rice field* under the *moon*: the farmer **says** it will rain.
*Upstairs* a boss with a sharp *eye* sees every *crumb* and points with a *right hand*: he **supervises**.
A *mother* finds a strange *seedling top* in the salad and throws it away: **poison**!
*Water drops* won't mix with the dark slick in the *pit*: **oil**.
A *swaddled baby* on a *sickbed*, nursed back to health: **cured**.
A flag on a *square* pole and people marching under it: they **travel** together.
*Water drops* gather in a low hollow and frogs move in: a **pond**.
A *tree* is cut down and a *green shoot* grows from the stump: wood is a renewable **material**.
A *plank* is dropped flat on the *campfire*: the flames are **put out**.
Down the *road* a farmer runs after his escaped *pig*: he **chases** it.
The *sun* sinks into the *grass* and a *big man* holds up his hand: "**do not** go out in the dark."
A *bamboo* handle with a tuft of *fur* at the tip: a **writing brush**.
A *drop* of life slips into the *hiding box* and is gone: to **die**.
*Fish* caught today, *sheep* milked this morning: everything is **fresh**.
A *small speech bubble* from the *boss* says one **word**: "No."
A *right hand* blesses the *soil* and crops grow: a holy **sage**.
A *helping hand* hovers over the fruit stall, picking the best: it **chooses**.
A *comb* parts the hair and a *thumb* pokes through: you **search** for the lost earring.
A *shelf bracket* of a roof over a big open floor: a **factory**.
An *eye* closes and you lie down on the soft *grass*: **sleep**.
By the *cross* in the *seedbed* a gardener measures with his *thumb*: his knowledge of plants is **extensive**.
A *strong arm* pulls the *rawhide* straps tight: he **reins in** the horse.
A *big man* inside a *fence* burns leaves on a *campfire*: **smoke** drifts everywhere.
One *helping hand* passes a book to another *right hand*: the teacher **teaches** the pupil.
A *small speech bubble* rises from a *mouth*, a *left hand* is laid on the *grass*: "I **promise**."
A *standing person* and a *person* share a *spoon* of soup: family ties, **human relations**.
A *mountain* and a *cliff* drop down to fishermen's *drying racks*: the **shore**.
A *big man* in a hooded cloak vanishes into the house: how **mysterious**.
In a grand *shed* of a hall, poets boast and exaggerate: the golden **Tang dynasty**.
A *shopping basket* marked with a *cross* for sale: you **sell** your goods.
A *standing person* with a *halberd* in one *hand* guards the snowy border: **Russia**.
*Two planks* thrown on the *campfire* hide a firecracker: they **explode**!
*Soil* is loaded onto a *cart*, guarded by a *halberd*: it **carries** the load.
*Water drops* flow past *trudging feet* and a singing *mouth*: the old **Luo River**.
A *standing person* takes a *long stride* and writes with a *writing brush* all day: active and **healthy**.
*Soil* packed flat under a huge roof: the main **hall**.
Flags fly from a *square* pole at the **side** of the road.
Under one *roof*, *mouth* after *mouth* of rooms: a **palace**.
A *mouth* in the *sun* and a *cloaked beggar* holding out a cup: he begs to **drink**.
A *standing person* jumps the *hurdle* in the *sun* to **borrow** his neighbour's ladder.
A *magistrate* opens his *mouth* and everyone obeys: he is the **monarch**.
Two *trees* guard an *altar*: entry is **forbidden**.
The *hillside* is grey; only a pale *moon* shows: the sky is **overcast**.
Inside a *fence*, *two planks* make a bench, where tired *legs* rest: a **garden**.
A *small speech bubble* whispers by the *tree*, offering *candy* as a bribe: they **plan** a trick.
A *tree* grows under the *roof* of an old house: the **Song dynasty** palace.
On the *road*, a *lying man* with a *mouth* full of *chili* waves: everyone **avoids** him.
A *helping hand* shaped like a *talon* **grabs** the prey.
A crown woven of *grass* and flowers: **glory** for the winner.
A *woman* with a *cross* on her necklace and a busy *mouth*: your father's sister, **aunt**.
A tiny *child*, no bigger than *crumbs*: the **grandson**.
*Legs* pump along the *road*: **escape**!
A *slash* down, a hook up: the shape of a **tooth**.
A *tree* trunk with a rope round its *mouth*: firewood **bound** into a bundle.
A *kicking foot* and bent *legs*: **jump**!
A *nail* hammered into the *page* at the very **top**.
The *king* wears one green *drop* on his belt: precious **jade**.
*Gold coins* under a *cross* and a watchful *eye*: the town guard **calms** the market.
*Rain* freezes and is swept up with a *comb*: **snow**.
The *drying rack* casts no shadow, only a tiny *slide*: it is **noon**.
Over and over the girl knots the *silk thread*: she **practises** every day.
On the *road* a *white dove* is chased into a corner: **forced** to land.
A *father* grown old with a bent back: **grandpa**.
*Bamboo* slips hang by the *door* under the *archway* with *grass* tied round them: a whole **piece of writing**.
Two *persons* wait under the *archway* of the butcher's shop to buy **meat**.
A *mouth* with a *stop sign*, a *spoon* and an *ox horn* stuffed in: what a big **mouth**.
A *side dish* served under a *roof* from *stacked drawers* of food: a public eating **building**, a restaurant.
Down the *road*, past every *door* and *archway*, through the *grass*: **everywhere**.
A plain *small table* with one *drop* of ink on it: totally **ordinary**.
A *stone* laid under two *mountains*: the **foundation**.
*Water drops* drip under the *archway* of rock into a *covered mouth*: a deep **hole**.
A *bowing man* with *horns* on his cap rolls up the *curtains*: he **rolls** them **up**.
*Soil* stretches out under the *sunrise*: open and **flat**.
One long *slide* of a horn and a yoke across the back: an **ox**.
A *nail* hangs a lamp under the *roof*: home is **peaceful**.
*Silk thread* scraps and the bark of a *family tree*, pulped and pressed: **paper**.
A *small speech bubble* from *grey hair* in the *sun*: "listen, **all** of you."
A *small speech bubble* gives orders flowing like a *river*: the coach **trains** his team.
A *grain stalk* hidden under one *elbow*: that is **private**.
A *shed* on the *soil* and some fields: a little **village**.
A *stepladder* by the *small altar* to reach the old portraits: your **ancestors**.
Two twisted threads hang from a *plank*: **silk**.
*Animal tracks* across the *rice field*, *feathers* everywhere: a hen **turned over** the soil.
The *sun* blazes and a sudden storm hits: **violent** weather.
A *tree*, a *tree* and another *tree*: a dense **forest**.
On the *soil*, among the *grass*, a *tent*-shaped roof over a *mouth* of a door, stacked high: a **pagoda**.
A *dog* covered in *soot* hides in the dark, perfectly **silent**.
A *helping hand* reaches the *lying man* where the *arrow landing* was: it **grasps** his hand.
A *right hand* waves a *halberd* on stage: a **drama**.
On the *hillside* a *bent knife*, a *comb* and a *heart* are buried: **hidden** treasures.
A *child* sees a *pill*-sized berry go soft on the *embers*: now it is **ripe**.
Under an *archway* of ribs, by the light of the *moon*: a **bone**.
A *small speech bubble* says hello at every *square* in town: you **visit** friends.
Two bent bows with tiny feathers: too **weak** to shoot.
*Grass* is thrown over a *blanket*: it **covers** everything.
Two *nails* hold up two *mouths*, and a third *yawns* wide: they all join the **song**.
A *shed* with a *little fortune stick* sign and a *mouth* calling out: a **shop**.
A pale head floating over a swirling tail in the dark: a **ghost**.
The *cart* sinks into the mud and the driver *yawns*: everything is **soft**.
*Two planks* hold books over a *pit*, behind *curtains*: the sacred **canon**.
You stare across the *valley* at a feast and *yawn* with hunger: pure **desire**.
A statue sits calmly in the *grass*: the **Bodhisattva** (萨 is the sà of púsà).
A *standing person* sits by the *campfire* and shares the meal: a **companion**.
On the *road* under a scorching *sun*: you **suffer** the heat.
A little *boat*-shaped *dish*: a **plate**.
A *father* wrestles a *python* in the yard: that's **dad**.
